_comment: The Grade 1 English standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools. Order here IS the unit number, and here it is also the COURSE's unit number: unlike the Maths builds, whose lessons are organised by strand, one lesson is one unit of the shell course. See THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py and the README beside this file before changing progressUnitPrefix. That 1:1 mapping is what makes u01..u10 defensible here and nowhere else, and it was the owner's decision to make, taken 2026-09-08: lesson N IS unit N, so the gradebook and the family portal may read these as unit completions. Progress written under the earlier l01..l10 is NOT migrated - a row saying 'steps 1-6 of lesson 3' cannot honestly be relabelled 'Unit 3 partly complete' - so anyone mid-unit starts that unit's reporting again; local resume is untouched.
subject: english
_taskSteps: The unit's writing and speaking tasks as two steps of their own ('Write it yourself', 'Talk it through'). Without them 'Write a sentence' and 'Say it out loud' reach 10 of 60 writing and 21 of 60 speaking tasks in this grade. Turned on 2026-09-11, the same day as Grade 4.
